name: Ishizeki Kaoru
source:
An idol who have the looks of a pure hearted and beautiful girl.
Dislike Nishijima for lowering her physic grade.
Her youthful body will be violated for that poor grade.
Timid but have a bright and cheerful personality, couldn't refuse or fight her friends.
